div.div: أَثْبَجُ Broad, or wide, in the part called the ثَبَج; (S, K, Msb, TA;) and large in the جَوْف [i. e. chest, or belly]: (TA:) or protuberant, or prominent, in the ثَبَج: (S, A, Mgh, Msb, K:) or humpbacked: (TA in this art., and in art. عجر on the authority of Fr:) and having a projecting, or prominent, breast, or chest: (L:) dim. ↓ أُثَيْبِجُ , occurring in a trad. (S, Mgh, Msb, * K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
